main.description: A canvas and its painted cells, or with `since` only the cells painted at or after it. A change on the live socket says only that the board moved; a listener then asks for what was painted since the `now` of its last answer, so a repaint costs everyone watching a few bytes and not the board again. A cell painted in the very millisecond of `since` may come twice, which repaints it the same colour.

cells.description: Rows of `[x, y, colour, painter, painted_at]`, oldest first. `colour` indexes the client's palette; `painter` indexes `painters`, or is null.

profiles.description: A map from DID to profile, for `painters`.

now_ms.description: The server's clock, which `next_paint_at` is on.

next_paint_at.description: Unix milliseconds at which the caller may paint again. Absent if they never have.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such canvas, or none the caller may read.
